direct.eyebrow: ◈ Already growing · Looking for good food ◈
direct.title: From the field straight to the home - without building anything from scratch
direct.p1: Not every farming story starts with an empty plot and a group still taking shape. Many farmers already grow good produce and sell it through a chain where much of the price stays with people who neither grew it nor picked it. Meanwhile, not far from the field, families looking for truly fresh vegetables and fruit buy whatever is left on the shelf after days of transport and cold storage, with no idea who grew it.
direct.p2: 1💗1 connects the two sides directly. You do not need to open a rikma, give up your farm's independence or change what you grow: list your produce, mark how far you reach and set your own price. The concierge brings you to people who write that they are looking for exactly this, and a demand pool gathers neighbours from one area for you, so instead of chasing single orders you get one delivery round that is worth picking and driving for.
direct.p3: The risk shrinks here too: an offer on a pool only goes ahead if the number of signers you set is reached by the date you set. You know how much to pick before you pick it, and customers know exactly who grew what reaches them.
direct.farmer_t: Farmers with produce: three ways to sell directly
direct.f1_d: Add your produce as a fixed-price product with your location and delivery radius. People looking for a box or produce in your area see you and order, and you get notified and arrange it with them directly.
direct.f2_t: Make an offer on a demand pool
direct.f2_d: The demand map shows how many households in your area are looking for produce. Make a threshold offer: what is in the box, the price, minimum signers, capacity, and a weekly, biweekly or monthly schedule.
direct.f3_t: Send a personal offer by link
direct.f3_d: For a regular customer, a neighbourhood restaurant or a kindergarten that came to you: write an offer and send a link. Nothing closes until both sides sign the same version.
direct.farmerMap: See who is looking in my area
direct.farmerShop: Set up a shop for my produce
direct.customer_t: Customers: a fresh, high-quality food box, straight from the grower
direct.c1_d: A weekly veggie box for the family, seasonal fruit, vegetables for a kindergarten or a community kitchen. The concierge looks for who in your area can supply it and brings you offers.
direct.c2_d: Joining a demand pool is soft and reversible, and only signing an offer commits you. The more households in your area join, the more worthwhile it is for a farmer to come regularly.
direct.c3_t: Know who you are buying from
direct.c3_d: Talk directly with the grower: what goes in the box, when it was picked, how it reaches you and for how much. No shelf in the middle and no guessing.

problem.title: The difficulty of founding an agricultural venture alone
problem.lead: The dream sounds simple and pure: to work the land, grow healthy food and earn a dignified living. But in reality, the challenges on the ground are almost impassable for individuals.
problem.b1: Lack of available land - and a natural fear among landowners of renting it out long-term.
problem.b2: High setup costs for equipment, seedlings and infrastructure before the first product is sold.
problem.b3: Marketing instability - without guaranteed customers upfront, a significant portion of the yield may go to waste.
problem.b4: Burnout and loneliness - hard physical work around the clock, without the ability to take rest days or backup.
problem.cost: This is how the dream fades, and the fertile land remains desolate.
problem.turn: At 1💗1 we turn every barrier into an opportunity for another partner in the circle

weave.title: The rikma - a living partnership inspired by nature
weave.sub: In 1💗1, a partnership is called a 'rikma' - inspired by living tissue in a living body. Each cell in the rikma has full independence, a unique role and freedom of action, and together they create a whole, pulsing, functioning organism that enables shared flourishing without giving up personal freedom.
weave.r1_t: The soil cell and anchor of the venture
weave.r1_d: Provides available land for the venture, participates in decision-making and enjoys a fair return. The land comes back to life instead of lying fallow.
weave.r2_d: Prepares and nurtures quality seedlings as part of the initial investment in the rikma, and professionally accompanies the growing process.
weave.r3_d: Comes to practical work in the field out of passion and connection to the land. Working hours and energy are transparently translated into ownership in the rikma.
weave.r4_d: Ensures continuity and stability. When rest or vacation is needed, other partners support and fill in, so the land and rikma continue to flourish.
weave.r5_t: The nervous system: synchronization and fairness
weave.r5_d: 1💗1's technological interface functions like a quiet nervous system: it coordinates, documents each cell's contribution, and distributes profits by full consensus.
weave.note: There is no pyramidal structure of 'employers' and 'employees' here. There is an equal rikma - each cell has freedom and independence, and everyone complements one another in harmony.

demand.title: Start from the community - reduce the risk
demand.sub: Instead of growing and hoping someone buys, we flip the equation and base everything on pre-defined demand.
demand.p1: Local residents express interest and pre-order a regular seasonal vegetable box.
demand.p2: Around this demand, landowners, growers and carers in the same area organize together.
demand.p3: We grow exactly what was ordered and in the required quantity - no surplus, no waste and maximum freshness.
demand.basket: A weekly, local and rich vegetable box - built especially for the people waiting for it.

paths.title: Two growth paths - your choice
paths.simple_d: Grow, sell, and income is automatically and simply divided among all partners according to their investment ratio and hours.
paths.economy_d: Building a comprehensive subscription system around the community's needs: weekly boxes, complementary products and broad community integration.
paths.note: You can start simply with basic sales, and expand to a full local economy at the pace that's right for you.

tools.title: Everything you need to sell is already built
tools.sub: Whether you are a single farmer or a rikma of partners, you can run a full shop and sales system without building a server or adding a separate admin panel.
tools.t1_t: An online shop of your own
tools.t1_d: A ready-made template that goes live in one click: catalogue, box sizes as variants, cart and an order tracking page. Buyers do not need to register.
tools.t2_d: Stripe, PayPal, or arranged payment by phone, WhatsApp, Bit or bank transfer. The money goes straight to you and never passes through 1💗1.
tools.t3_d: Delivery zones and rates, pickup points including pickup by appointment, and email updates to the buyer along the way.
tools.t4_d: One screen for stock, orders and customer inquiries, with call and WhatsApp buttons and one-click "shipped".
tools.t5_d: Each order can open tasks for whoever agreed to receive them and update your stock of crates and jars. With partners, every sale counts automatically toward the split.
tools.t6_t: A friendly API and AI agents
tools.t6_d: REST API and signed webhooks to connect an existing site, and MCP tools to manage products, stock and orders in a conversation with Claude or any AI agent.
tools.link: Everything about the shop and sales system
tools.linkHint: The shop template, payments, automations and API

how.title: Four simple steps to get started
how.s1_d: Available land? Growing ability? Free time and working hands? Or perhaps a wish to support as consumers? Every contribution is an excellent starting point.
how.s2_d: We connect complementary partners in the same geographic area to create a harmonious and balanced working group.
how.s3_d: We define and approve digitally and clearly in advance the division of roles, investments and how profits are shared.
how.s4_d: The garden sets off, the produce reaches consumers, and income is shared according to the model agreed upon transparently.

who.title: Who is this for?
who.sub: For anyone who wants to take part in real ecological and social change, and for anyone who wants to consume clean, quality food.
who.w1_d: Who want to see their land yielding and returning life, through social involvement and partnership.
who.w2_d: People who want to turn their passion into practical, rewarding agricultural work without capital.
who.w3_t: Farmers at the beginning of their journey
who.w3_d: Who want to gain practical experience, build community and reduce the startup and marketing risks involved in starting alone.
who.w4_d: Who aspire to strengthen their economic and social resilience through cooperative, connecting local agriculture.
who.w5_d: People who want fresh, local vegetables directly from the field, and to get to know the partners who grew them.
who.w6_d: Farms already growing that want to sell directly to customers through the concierge, demand pools or their own shop, and keep a larger part of the price.

values.title: The values that drive us
values.v1_d: From seed to plate and back to the soil. We minimize the intermediary gaps and food waste to the minimum possible.
values.v2_d: Each partner focuses on what they do best and love. The work is done from connection and fulfilment, not from burnout.
values.v3_d: Clear and accessible documentation of every hour, resource and fruit enables building long-term relationships based on true partnership.

cta.title: The land is ready, the community is waiting
cta.sub: Whether you have produce to sell, land to offer, working hands, know-how or simply the wish to eat healthy local food - there is a place for you in our circle.
